It closes the Arden Key and Derrick Harmon replacement inputs, Yahya Black final availability, the zero-valued Roman Wilson and Ben Skowronek in-game exits, and both quarterback duty reviews. sources.finding: Official final gamebook records Pittsburgh 34, Indianapolis 22; complete starters, substitutes, DNP and inactive inventories; Daniel Jones on all 71 Indianapolis offensive snaps; Aaron Rodgers on 58 of 60 Pittsburgh offensive snaps with Mason Rudolph taking only the final two victory-formation kneels; JT Tuimoloau as an Indianapolis starting defensive end with 49 defensive snaps; Yahya Black as an active Pittsburgh starting defensive lineman with 32 defensive snaps; Gabriel Rubio with 14 defensive snaps; Roman Wilson with 20 offensive snaps; Ben Skowronek with five offensive snaps; and the literal third-quarter injury-status updates.

Official final report lists Indianapolis Ashton Dulin, Darius Slayton, Will Mallory, Arden Key and Jaylon Carlies out; Pittsburgh Michael Pittman, Jamel Dean and DeShon Elliott out; and Rico Dowdle and Yahya Black questionable.

Indianapolis confirms Darius Slayton, Ashton Dulin and Jaylon Carlies injury-inactive; Riley Leonard as third quarterback; Dalton Tucker inactive; and Arden Key placed on injured reserve before the game.
Pittsburgh confirms Rico Dowdle remained inactive and Jamel Dean was injury-inactive. The gamebook separately confirms Yahya Black active and starting.
Pittsburgh's initial 2026 depth chart establishes Derrick Harmon, Yahya Black and Cameron Heyward as the three defensive-line starters and Gabriel Rubio as a reserve in the same defensive-line room.

Pittsburgh's postgame review explicitly identifies Yahya Black and Gabriel Rubio as the two defensive linemen who received extended playing time and stepped up against Indianapolis while Derrick Harmon was on injured reserve.

Pittsburgh reports that with Jamel Dean out, Asante Samuel Jr. and Daylen Everette drew the starting corner assignments. Their disjoint added-duty allocation and frozen-value treatment still require reconciliation before Dean's injury loss can be used.

IND.finding: Daniel Jones started and handled all 71 Indianapolis offensive snaps. Anthony Richardson and D.J. Giddens were DNP reserve identities, and Riley Leonard was the inactive third quarterback; no injury-driven change of primary quarterback duty occurred.

PIT.finding: Aaron Rodgers handled all 58 competitive Pittsburgh offensive snaps and every pass attempt. Mason Rudolph's only two snaps were victory-formation kneels at 1:14 and 0:35, not injury relief.
